summary: The audit checks MTL 334A, 334B and 334C, ENGLISH 396L, 135 units of graduate work, and the reading course (B or better) if you use one for a language. Checked by hand: eight graduate literature courses and eight interdisciplinary courses outside the literature departments, each taken for a letter grade and at least 3 units, which you move in; reading knowledge of two foreign languages (by exam, reading course, or a 100-level or higher literature course in a foreign language department with a B or better); the qualifying paper, two teaching quarters, candidacy, the oral exam, the prospectus and the dissertation.

5qdxrGTC.why: "Eight graduate-level courses in the study of modern literature and/or literary and cultural theory in courses offered by departments of literature. Courses should be taken for letter grades for a minimum of three units. Students must take a coherent program of eight courses of advanced work in literary studies (to be worked out with the advisor)" "ENGLISH396L (Pedagogy Seminar I), MTL399 (Reading for Orals), MTL802 (TGR Dissertation) may not be counted". The literature departments are not given as subject codes, so the student moves the courses in. Grading: "Courses should be taken for letter grades for a minimum of three units." A course moved in must carry a letter grade; the 3-unit minimum is checked by hand.

kx6hba0r.why: "Eight graduate-level courses outside of literature departments (English, DLCL, EALC) in a coherent and individually arranged interdisciplinary program, the core of which is completing either a departmental minor or an interdepartmental concentration" "At the end of the first year, each student must submit to the Director of Graduate Studies a preliminary statement of approximately 1500 words". The program is individually arranged, so the student moves the courses in. "Courses should be taken for letter grades for a minimum of three units." A course moved in must carry a letter grade; the 3-unit minimum is checked by hand.

axo7h9jT.why: "The qualifying paper must be a substantial revision of a seminar paper written at Stanford during the first year" "Qualifying papers must be submitted no later than the end of the third week of the winter quarter of the second year."

byDCD6CL.why: "All students are required to complete 2 quarters of teaching experience by the end of their third year" and "In the winter or spring of their second year, students are expected to complete a teaching experience in one class in the English Department or another literature department."

OgztCfyU.why: "In their third year, students are expected to complete a teaching experience in one class in an interdisciplinary department or program."

bohn5QFK.why: "At the end of the second year, students apply for candidacy. Candidacy applications are evaluated and voted on by the Faculty Committee in Charge."

Bd3w7349.why: "It is a two to three-hour oral examination administered by a committee of at least five members"

iVIOw1bA.why: "Within one quarter of the university oral examination, the student submits the dissertation proposal." "The proposal is submitted to the program director and the dissertation committee for approval."

eiJ15DAC.why: "The fourth and fifth years are devoted to the dissertation, which should be a substantial and original contribution acceptable to the Committee in Charge of Modern Thought and Literature."

zj2tdHab.why: "Before the beginning of the second year of study, students must demonstrate a reading knowledge of one foreign language and, by spring quarter of the third year, a reading knowledge of one other foreign language." Two languages, each met in any of the listed ways: "passing a reading examination given by the various language departments", a PhD reading course that "must be completed with a grade of B or higher", or "passing, with a grade of B or higher, a course in literature numbered 100 or higher in a foreign language department at Stanford". Foreign language departments are not subject codes, so the literature course is moved in by hand. The stored rule asked for one language. The literature course moved in must carry a B or higher.
